But the hectare figure animates through false numbers, which breaks the brief, and the measured contrast failure plus visible layout/capture fragility make the execution feel less dependable.

B.notes: This has the stronger idea: the site moves from nursery to forest, and the plant-growth sequence in the scroll frames is purposeful and well matched to the mission. Typography, structure, and bilingual presentation feel more distinctive than A, but the six measured contrast failures are a hard-gate miss.

raw.why: B carries one coherent concept further, uses motion more meaningfully, and stays faithful to the 140-hectare fact, whereas A undermines itself with animated fake intermediate statistics.
